Flow.description: ALF-RS-08 FR16 / AC5: releases the vehicle stock hold whenever a reservation reaches Expired or Cancelled. AF_FL_Reservation_ExpiryAutomation only covers the scheduled path that fires on the expiry date, so a reservation cancelled by hand - or expired manually before its date - never had its stock flagged. This before-save flow closes that hole for every route into those two statuses. Stock release is set to "Pending Release" rather than "Released": actual confirmation is Keyloop-owned, matching the existing invoicing pattern.
Flow.label: Reservation Stock Release On Close

start.filterFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.AF_Status__c}, "Expired"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.AF_Status__c}, "Cancelled") ), ISCHANGED({!$Record.AF_Status__c}), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT({!$Record.AF_StockReleaseStatus__c})), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.AF_StockReleaseStatus__c}, "N/A") ) )
